We evaluate MAGICORE on seven reasoning datasets (including math, commonsense and logical reasoning) with two LLMs: Llama-3-8B and GPT-3.5.
we leverage external global and local Reward Models (RMs) that enhance both aggregation and refinement processes.

We incorporate three types of models: (1) an LLM interchangeably performing three roles..., (2) an Outcome Reward Model (ORM) for generating global, solution-level correctness score, and (3) a Process Reward Model (PRM) for generating local step-by-step correctness scores.
Based on their strong performance on standard reward modeling evaluations, we choose InternLM-7B as the ORM, and Math-Shepherd-7B as the PRM for computing the RM scores.
